sentences: Word unification solves equations between concatenations by substituting strings for variables.
The saved question asks for the exact computational complexity of deciding whether such substitutions exist.
Even a short equation can have solutions whose direct representations are long.
A sharp classification would clarify the algorithmic cost of a basic constraint language used in symbolic reasoning.
